preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The value of k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: S.islower() and all(c.isalpha() for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > len(S) or len(S) - k == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than the length of S or the resulting string is empty, output -1.
The length of the output string must be equal to the length of S minus k.
The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string after removing k characters.
